Interface GameListener

All Known Subinterfaces:
TicTacToeUI
All Known Implementing Classes:
CLIUI, SwingUI
public interface GameListener
Listener interface for receiving events from a TicTacToeGame. Implement this interface and register it with TicTacToeGame.addListener(GameListener) to be notified when the game state changes.

      void onGameOver(TicTacToeGame.Mark winner)

      winner - the winning mark, or TicTacToeGame.Mark.EMPTY if the game ended in a draw

      void onReset(TicTacToeGame.Mark starting)
      Called after the game has been reset and is ready to play again.
